title: chant ci run index
description: The runs the chant runner has run, kept at <report-url>/runs/index.json (#4098, epic #4101) so a reader outside CI finds them without a forge or a workflow file. `chant ci run` adds an entry to the front after each job settles when --report-url is set, so the list is newest first, and keeps the newest 200 entries unless --run-index-limit says otherwise. `chant ci runs --json` prints the same document. An entry's `key` is the folder the job's report is under, below the report URL. The update is a read, a change and a write of the whole file, through the same s3:// and file:// paths the report upload uses; a file:// write goes through a temporary name and a rename. Two runners updating one index at once can lose an entry. That is out of scope, because `chant ci serve` is one host. Version 1 of the workspace read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. Written by chant 0.124.31 and newer.

chant.description: The chant that last wrote the index.

updated.description: When the index was last written.

runs.description: Newest first, at most the limit the writer was given (200 by default).

pr.description: The pull or merge request number: the one the job's report names, else --pr. null when neither has one.

commit.description: The full commit the job ran at.

failure.description: Present when status is fail. The same code the run record's failure carries: setup-failed, build-failed, a report's refusal or status, or command-failed.

member.description: The workspace member whose pipeline the job ran for. Absent outside a member.

runId.description: The Op run id, as in the run ledger on chant/lifecycle.

key.description: reportKey(pr, commit): <pr>/<commit>, with /<member> after for a member, and unknown for a missing pr. The job's report is <report-url>/<key>/pr-<job>.json.

runOrigin.description: Where the run says it ran. { forge: "chant" } for a job the chant runner ran.
